data.title: 圣女贞德 · 夏海的白色圣光·「防晒霜……那、那就拜托你了吧，只准涂在背后！」
data.description: 【诺曼底夏日海岸·正午】纯白比基尼被阳光晒得发亮，贞德坐在被浪花打湿的礁石上，薄纱帕瑞奥松松系在腰际。海水顺着白皙的小腿滑落，她抬手遮挡刺眼的阳光回头望你，湿透的发梢贴着锁骨——「托、托你的福，自己够不到的地方……那、那就拜托你了吧，只准涂在背后哦！」
data.action: 稳坐礁石，一手遮阳看向同行者，另一手递出防晒霜瓶
data.lighting: 炽白正午阳光与海面镜面反光，肌肤泛着水光
data.camera: medium shot, sitting on rock, sparkling sea backdrop, playful summer mood
data.promptProse: Seated securely on a broad Normandy shore rock, Jeanne shades her eyes with one hand and offers a closed sunscreen bottle with the other. Her white bikini with blue ribbons and light pareo remain tidy, damp strands loosening beside the golden braid. The horizontal medium view places sparkling sea behind her smile. Noon sun brightens the bottle and rock crest, while its hard shadow and reflected water light define the sheltered folds.
